The issue: `if and(packed, 0x1) { ... } else { ... }` — assembly if doesn't support else. Convert to if/else statement properly: use `switch` or restructure. Also `0x0100 ** ...` in assembly? That's outside assembly, fine but expression weirdness. Actually the else is inside assembly block. Fix: use switch.

Also the return lines: `abi.encodePacked(0x20, length)` — 0x20 is uint8 literal fine. The mask expression: `~(0x0100 ** (0x20 - (0x1f & length)) - 0x01) & data` — fine in Solidity? `~` on int literal... 0x0100**x is literal, ok. But better compute cleanly. Minimal: fix assembly if/else via switch.
